title: Gameplay Framework Map
summary: Every class family in Unreal — core objects, actors, components, the framework eight, subsystems, input, AI, animation, physics, rendering, audio, UI, networking, abilities, data — with what each one owns, C++ examples, the lifecycle order, and a table for deciding where a piece of logic belongs. Filter box at the top searches every row.
why: Look-up material, not a drill. The placement practice asks you to decide; this is what you check the decision against, and what to reach for when the question is which class a feature belongs in.
